items.prompt: Under unit-cost visits, a complete scan of n entries visits each entry once. What is its tight visit-count order?

options.text: Theta(n), because the exact visit count is n
options.why: Both eventual linear lower and upper bounds hold.

options.text: Theta(1), because a loop has one source line
options.why: Source-line count is not iteration count.

options.text: Theta(n²), because every scan has two nested loops
options.why: The stated scan has only one visit per entry.

options.text: Exactly n milliseconds on every machine
options.why: Operation counts do not specify wall-clock duration.

items.explanation: The tight order refers to the stated counted operation and complete-scan contract, not an unspecified early-exit algorithm.
